lines.zh: 我沿着闪电芦苇的茎爬
lines.en: I climb along a lightning reed's stalk.
My six legs alternate very quickly.

lines.zh: 我在风暴丛林里横着跳
lines.en: I hop sideways through the storm jungle.
The leaf trembles where I kick off.

lines.zh: 我的触角一直扫着空气
lines.en: My antennae sweep the air constantly.

lines.zh: 我落在湿漉漉的苔藓上
lines.en: I land on damp moss.
Three of my kin wait ahead.
I hop a ditch, lightly.

lines.zh: 棕色的甲壳在叶下很暗
lines.en: My brown shell is dark under the leaves.

lines.zh: 我爬过一截湿透的树干。
lines.en: I crawl over a soaked fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 雨点打在我背上，我照走
lines.en: Rain hits my back; I keep going.

lines.zh: 我把后腿蜷起，准备再跳
lines.en: I fold my hind legs to jump again.
The vine is slick, so I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕着芦苇根转了一圈
lines.en: I circle the reed's base once.
I stop at the leaf tip and look down.

lines.zh: 我趴在叶背上一动不动
lines.en: I lie still on the leaf's underside.
Water runs everywhere in this jungle.

lines.zh: 我的后腿贴着身子收好
lines.en: My hind legs are tucked close.

lines.zh: 触角在听雷雨里的脚步。
lines.en: My antennae listen for steps in the storm.

lines.zh: 闪电芦苇的茎里有电流味
lines.en: The reeds smell faintly of current.
I twitch my wing stubs.
This leaf will do me for a day.

lines.zh: 我的同类在旁边互相碰触角
lines.en: My kin touch antennae nearby.
I chew slowly on a tender leaf.

lines.zh: 有水珠顺着叶脉滚下来
lines.en: A droplet rolls down the vein.
I wait for the rain to ease.
My shell feels cool.

lines.zh: 附近没有大的东西在动
lines.en: Nothing large moves nearby.
I clean my forelegs.
The jungle air is thick.

lines.zh: 你拨开叶子，我们碰上了
lines.en: You part the leaves and we meet.
You're dozens of times my height.
I don't run. I wait right here.
My hind legs are already cocked.

lines.zh: 你伸手的样子我看得清
lines.en: I can see your hand coming.
This patch is our nest ground.

lines.zh: 同类都往芦苇深处退了
lines.en: My kin have drawn back into the reeds.

lines.zh: 我留下，是因为我挡得住
lines.en: I stay because I can stop you.

lines.zh: 你的影子把整片叶子罩住
lines.en: Your shadow covers the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 我不怕大东西，我怕快的
lines.en: Big things don't scare me. Fast ones do.
Don't move so quickly.
I tilt my head to see your next move.

lines.zh: 叶子上的水把你鞋弄湿了
lines.en: The leaf water soaks your boots.
This is my ground. Understand?
I press my body into the wet leaves.
Either leave, or try.
Try it and you'll be numb a long while.
I point my antennae at you.
You stepped back. Sensible.
Good. Then we leave it there.
I'm knocked half a leaf away.
One of my legs is shaking.
I flip over and right myself.
A white scratch on my shell.
I retreat deep into the reeds.
My kin chirp once and flee.
My shell cracked a little; I can still hop.
One antenna is bent.
You're stronger than I thought.
One more and I'm done.

lines.zh: 闪电芦苇？我认得那个味道
lines.en: Lightning reeds? I know that smell.
Hold it steady, don't shake.
That thing calms me down.
I crawl over slowly. No hurry.
Hold still; I'll take it myself.

lines.zh: 同类也想过来，被挤开了
lines.en: My kin crowd in and get pushed aside.
It smells like air before rain.
I stop halfway to sniff.
Too high. I can't reach.
Just set it on the leaf.
I take one end and chew slowly.
When I'm done, I won't follow you.
That's not enough. Any more?
Back off so I can eat in peace.
My antennae have relaxed.

lines.zh: 这算是我们之间的交情
lines.en: Call this a small truce between us.
But no further than that.
You touch me and I spring away.

lines.zh: 我的身子很轻，撞不动你
lines.en: I'm light. I can't move you.
Your finger tips me over.
I right myself and crawl on.
That knocked a numbness into my legs.
You step on the leaf and I sway.
I retreat to the leaf's stem.
Touch me again and I won't hold back.
My shell is very slick.
Hard to catch. I jump fast.

lines.zh: 我从你的指缝里钻出去
lines.en: I slip out between your fingers.
Now I'm flat against the leaf's underside.
Our nest is under the reed roots.

lines.zh: 碰碰触角，就知道是同类
lines.en: A touch of antennae and we know each other.
When the rain's heavy, we huddle.
Four of us here. That's right.
I jump a little higher than you.
Don't take that leaf.
We'll both watch the east side.
If something moves, give a chirp.

lines.zh: 风暴过去了，我们就出去
lines.en: When the storm passes, we go out.
This jungle is big enough for us.

lines.zh: 我用前足把它抱在胸前
lines.en: I hug it to my chest with my forelegs.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，差点漏过。
lines.en: So small — I nearly missed it.
I carry it back to the reed roots.
This will line the nest nicely.
You dropped it? I have it.
My kin gather at once.
Carrying it slows my climb.
Too heavy. I'll push it.
This is of little use.
But I won't leave it for others.
You crushed a reed.
That's reason enough.
I cock my hind legs tighter.
My antennae press down.
This jump lands on your hand.
I don't bite. I only numb.
You strike, I answer.
One touch from me and you go numb.
There's no way back for me.
Come on. Try it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你伸过来的手指。
lines.en: I watch your reaching finger.
My chirp can numb you.
I circle to the back of your hand.
This leaf is my high ground.
I'm counting the number of your breaths.
The more you rush, the less you catch.
My legs stay cocked.
The instant you reach is your slowest.
I'm waiting for it.
Just a little more now.

lines.zh: 我一跳撞在你的手背上
lines.en: I leap onto the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 麻感顺着你的手臂上去
lines.en: The numbness climbs your arm.
One kick from me and you stiffen.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，但你动不了
lines.en: It doesn't hurt, but you can't move.
I land and pull back at once.
Your fingers are twitching.
I don't like a drawn-out fight.
The numbness fades; then I leap again.

lines.zh: 你太大，我只能电你一下。
lines.en: You're huge — a shock is all I have.
But you can't catch me either.
I tumble down from a reed leaf.
Four of us join the storm jungle.
Damp moss underfoot.
I shake the rain off.

lines.zh: 这里的芦苇有电流的味道
lines.en: These reeds smell of current.
I'll climb high and look first.
Rain or not, we're active.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳还带着林子的湿气
lines.en: My shell still carries the jungle's damp.
Heavy footsteps nearby.
We scatter in different directions.
Heat makes my shell brittle.
I fall off the leaf into the mud.
Water traps me and my legs can't kick.
The blast throws me into the reeds.
An arrow pins through my shell.
That light leaves all my legs wooden.
Too starved to manage a jump.

lines.zh: 雷打在芦苇上，我全身发麻
lines.en: Lightning strikes the reeds and I go numb.
No leaves. Nowhere to land.
